messages:
sam-pm: Quick sync — I'm putting together a 'first-users' commitment playbook to replace the DP label. Goal: clear SLA, feedback cadence, and incentives. Who can help define acceptance criteria for Private + Hosted flows? cc @maria-ux @alex-eng

maria-ux: Happy to. Can we structure it as three phases: engage, validate, scale? keeps expectations clear.

alex-eng: Yes. From eng: we need telemetry and an eval suite. Propose latency, cost per 1k tokens, and a prompt-level quality regression check.

jin-sre: From infra side — Dedicated capacity needs a 24h lead for switches. For hosted baseline can we set p50 <200ms and p95 <600ms as target?

lina-ps: Incentives idea: $10k platform credits + 3 months priority onboarding for top 5 partners, OR 6 months free Dedicated for 2 anchors. Thoughts?

sam-pm: Prefer credits + guaranteed prioritization. Also acceptance criteria: no P0 regressions on our benchmark suite and >=90% pass rate on partner prompt set for the candidate model.

maria-ux: Feedback loop: weekly async notes (threaded) + biweekly 1:1s for the first 8 weeks, then monthly check-ins. Add a 6-question NPS-style survey after each milestone.

alex-eng: Recruitment filter: target teams running >=1000 calls/day and able to run our eval harness. We'll give a small test dataset and CI check:

alex-eng: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/eval -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"prompt_set":"first-users-v1"}'
```

jin-sre: Also need a rollback/runbook: if error rate >2% over 15m or latency doubles, auto-fallback to previous model. I'll draft runbook.

lina-ps: I'll draft the incentive offer language and the partner success SLA (uptime, response time, escalation path).

sam-pm: Action items: maria write engagement plan by Tue, alex to propose telemetry + eval set by Wed, lina to draft incentives & SLA by Wed, jin to deliver rollback runbook by Thu. Anyone else?

ops-bot: Reminder: schedule 'first-users kickoff' when onboarding doc is ready — use /poll to pick time slots.

maria-ux: :thumbsup: I'll post 3 meeting slots and include a short onboarding checklist. Also suggest an opt-out clause for partners after 30 days to reduce friction.

alex-eng: We'll gate new features behind flags during the program — no full prod traffic until a canary pass. Also need a short data-sharing agreement template.

sam-pm: Agreed. Success metrics to track: 60-day retention, unique prompt count growth, and model regression delta. We'll review first draft in next PM sync.
